scope: All 153 repository-owned image files and all 128 public sitemap pages. Customer uploads and external reviewer avatars were not inspected or changed.
assessment: Visual review cannot prove image origin. New scenes are AI-generated fictional illustrations with a natural photographic style.

newAssets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial industry photograph for Zyene Reviews. Create one believable candid documentary photograph in a real, ordinary local business setting. Natural daylight, 35mm camera perspective, restrained color, subtle grain, natural skin pores and fine lines, worn fabric and tools, realistic material texture. Main action centered within a square composition, enough surrounding environment for a wide responsive crop. Keep the person's head within the central vertical band and avoid tight framing. Anatomically natural hands and plausible tools, no glamour retouching, no forced smile, no orange cinematic grading, no glossy CGI, no readable text, no logos or watermarks. Fictional illustrative subject; not a real customer or a claim about safety procedures. Scene: a female HVAC technician in her early fifties with short brown hair, wearing a faded gray work shirt, crouches beside the exterior condenser of a modest suburban home on an overcast morning. The metal AC casing and a closed service tool bag are clearly visible; she studies the unit while holding a small plain notebook. Her face is viewed in natural three-quarter profile, unposed, with ordinary garden and weathered siding behind her.
newAssets.alt: HVAC technician inspecting an outdoor air-conditioning unit beside a home
newAssets.treatment: Resize to 900×900, WebP quality 83, method 6. No generative retouching after selection.

newAssets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial industry photograph for Zyene Reviews. One believable candid documentary photograph of a plumber working in an ordinary residential kitchen, square framing with the person and plumbing centered for square and wide responsive crops. A Latino man in his early sixties, with graying hair, wearing a faded dark blue work shirt and practical trousers, kneels beside an open under-sink cabinet. He looks carefully at the visible simple drain pipe, one natural hand holding a small adjustable wrench alongside the pipe without tangled fingers. An ordinary kitchen counter and small tool bag give believable context. Natural soft window light, 35mm camera perspective, restrained colors and fine photographic grain, realistic skin pores and age lines, worn tools and clothing. Place the subject's head in the central vertical band with generous breathing room; show plausible cabinet and pipe geometry. No forced smiles, airbrushing, glossy CGI, perfect staged interior, readable text, logos, brand interfaces or watermark. Fictional illustrative person, not actual customer proof or an instructional safety diagram.
newAssets.alt: Plumber checking a drain pipe beneath a kitchen sink
newAssets.treatment: Resize to 900×900, WebP quality 83, method 6. No generative retouching after selection.

newAssets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial industry photograph for Zyene Reviews. One believable candid documentary photograph, square framing with a central subject and enough room for a wide responsive crop. A Black male electrician in his forties with close-cropped hair, wearing a worn olive work shirt, stands at a practical workbench in a modest workshop, preparing a short length of electrical cable alongside a neatly placed set of insulated hand tools, a cable spool, and a closed toolbox. Show a quiet natural moment of him examining the cable, with anatomically normal hands and plausible tools, no exposed live panel or sparks. Soft ordinary window daylight, 35mm camera perspective, restrained colors, subtle grain, visible natural skin texture and fabric wear, everyday minor clutter. Keep the face and action near the center vertical band rather than the top edge. No glamour lighting, glossy CGI, stock-photo grin, orange cinematic color, text, logos or watermark. Fictional illustrative subject, not an actual customer or safety-procedure instruction.
newAssets.alt: Electrician preparing cable and tools at a workshop bench
newAssets.treatment: Resize to 900×900, WebP quality 83, method 6. No generative retouching after selection.
